title: myQ hub disconnected from internet
shortDescription: Smart Garage Hub shows error 1-1, internet not reachable.
fullDescription:
Error 1-1 on the myQ Smart Garage Hub indicates the device cannot reach the internet. The wifi LED is off or red. Common after router changes or DNS filtering.

MyQ requires outbound internet to api.myqdevice.com.

fixSteps.title: Re-add WiFi
fixSteps.instruction: Hold setup button until LED flashes blue. Use myQ app to re-add WiFi credentials.

title: myQ hub authentication failure
shortDescription: Hub failed to authenticate to myQ cloud.
fullDescription: Error 1-3 means the hub reaches the internet but cannot complete authentication with myQ servers. Often a temporary cloud issue, sometimes account/lockout related.
symptoms: App login okay but hub shows error 1-3

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Factory reset hub and re-add via myQ app.

faq.a: Rare; reset password and try again.

title: myQ hub paired but cannot reach garage opener
shortDescription: Hub online but cannot communicate with door opener.
fullDescription:
Error 1-5 means the hub is online but the radio link to the garage opener has failed. The hub uses 315 MHz to talk to the opener and must be paired (Learn button procedure).

Reposition the hub closer to the opener and re-pair.
symptoms: Door does not open via app

fixSteps.title: Move hub
fixSteps.instruction: Place hub within 25ft of garage door opener and within WiFi range.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair to opener
fixSteps.instruction: Press Learn on opener; within 30s press myQ app pair.

whenToCallPro: If opener requires button on ceiling unit and not safe to reach.

faq.a: Most LiftMaster and Chamberlain post-1993 with safety sensors.

title: App shows door position as 'unknown'
fullDescription:
The door state sensor is a tilt or magnetic sensor mounted on the door panel. If misaligned or battery dead, the hub does not know if the door is open or closed.

The sensor uses a CR2450 coin battery in older versions and AAA in newer.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Open sensor housing, replace CR2450 or AAA battery.

fixSteps.title: Re-mount
fixSteps.instruction: Mount sensor flat on top panel of door; arrow up.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Press setup on hub then sensor button.

faq.a: Some openers have built-in sensing; otherwise sensor is required.

title: Door beeps and flashes for 10 seconds before closing remotely
shortDescription: Safety warning when closing via myQ app.
fullDescription:
UL325 safety regulations require audible/visual warning before unattended closure. This is normal behavior, not an error. The door beeps and flashes for ~10 seconds before closing when triggered by the app or schedule.

It cannot be disabled.
symptoms: Beep and flash for 10s before close
Only happens with app close, not button

fixSteps.title: No fix needed
fixSteps.instruction: This is required by safety regulation. It cannot be disabled.

faq.q: Can I turn off the warning?

title: myQ Smart Garage Camera live view fails
shortDescription: Camera in opener will not stream to app.
fullDescription:
Newer LiftMaster openers include a myQ camera. If the live stream fails, the opener may need a firmware update via the wall control or the WiFi RSSI is too weak.

Reposition WiFi or add a mesh node nearby.

fixSteps.title: Check signal
fixSteps.instruction: myQ app > opener > Diagnostics. Confirm RSSI at opener.

fixSteps.title: Add mesh
fixSteps.instruction: Place mesh node in garage rafters or near opener.

title: Amazon delivery to garage failed
shortDescription: Driver could not open garage for in-garage delivery.
fullDescription:
Amazon Key in-garage delivery requires myQ hub online, door state known, and recent successful test. If any of these fail, driver leaves package outside.

After myQ outages, re-link the Key skill in Amazon and run a self-test.

causes.cause: myQ hub offline at delivery time

symptoms: Amazon notification: 'unable to deliver in garage'

fixSteps.title: Verify hub online
fixSteps.instruction: Open myQ app and confirm hub is online.

fixSteps.title: Test delivery
fixSteps.instruction: Run a self-test in Amazon Key (it will open then close door).

title: myQ does not appear in Apple Home
shortDescription: myQ removed native HomeKit support; works only via paid Homebridge or third-party.
fullDescription:
myQ removed native HomeKit support in 2018. Direct integration is not possible. Workarounds include Homebridge with the homebridge-myq plugin, or paid bridge devices like the StarLink myQ HomeKit Hub.

For Google and Alexa, native voice integration still works.
symptoms: No myQ devices in Home app
HomeKit code on hub no longer works

fixSteps.title: Use Homebridge
fixSteps.instruction: Install Homebridge on Raspberry Pi or Synology, add homebridge-myq plugin.

fixSteps.title: Use Alexa or Google
fixSteps.instruction: myQ still supports Alexa and Google Home natively.

faq.a: Unlikely; myQ now charges for Smart Home integration on some plans.

title: myQ hub WiFi signal too weak
shortDescription: Hub disconnects intermittently due to weak WiFi.
fullDescription:
myQ Smart Garage Hub mounts on the ceiling, often the worst spot for WiFi. RSSI below -70 dBm causes intermittent drops.

Use the myQ app diagnostics page to read RSSI; aim for -65 dBm or better.

causes.cause: Hub on ceiling far from router

fixSteps.title: Add mesh node
fixSteps.instruction: Plug a mesh WiFi node in the garage or nearest outlet.

faq.a: Better than -65 dBm preferred; below -75 dBm fails.

title: myQ app push notifications stop arriving
shortDescription: App stopped sending door open/close alerts.
fullDescription:
Push notifications can fail due to phone battery optimization killing background activity, app permission changes, or the notification rule being disabled.

iOS Focus modes and Android battery savers commonly silence myQ.

fixSteps.title: OS notification permission
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > myQ > Notifications: Allow all.

fixSteps.title: Battery optimization
fixSteps.instruction: Android: exempt myQ from battery optimization.

fixSteps.title: Rule check
fixSteps.instruction: myQ app > Notifications > confirm rules enabled per device.

faq.a: Yes; some advanced rules require subscription.

fullDescription: Photo eyes have a 6-inch beam across opening. Misalignment, dirt, or sun glare triggers reverse.

fullDescription: Learn button window is 30s on most openers. Yellow learn LED indicates pair mode.

fixSteps.title: Press correct learn
fixSteps.instruction: Yellow/orange button on opener motor head.

fixSteps.title: Pair within 30s
fixSteps.instruction: Press learn, then hub button immediately.
